description: This file defines a REST controller for user-related CRUD operations in a Spring Boot application. It handles listing users and creating new users, delegating the core logic to a UsersService component.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: A REST controller managing user CRUD endpoints, providing methods to list and create users.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all users by invoking the UsersService.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user using data from the request body.
